The strongest candidates are repeat offenders with evidence of substantial past funding episodes, rather than coins showing only isolated predicted dips. I also retained two pump/post-pump candidates; probabilities are anchored to the historical quiet-coin base rates and discounted where pressure is easing or spot liquidity is relatively strong.

All 15 selections passed `quiet__eq: true`. The ranking targets funding depth in January 8–14, not price direction; thin spot and high OI are arbitrage-capacity proxies, not confirmation that borrow is unavailable.
